affected_files.role: in-flight artifact carrying per-dispatch state-transition log (FR-4 inventory item 8)
key_observations: Format: JSONL, one object per line.

Per-entry schema (verified by reading first 12 entries): timestamp (ISO-8601 UTC), transition_name (T0|T13|T0-prime|T1|T5|...; allows custom suffix like '-prime' for void re-entry), from_state, to_state, trigger (free-form string), invoking_agent ('execute-orchestrator' verbatim across all 12 entries), task_id (string or null), phase_id (string; observed 'Phase-0' rather than 'phase-0' — case mismatch with template line 88 which uses 'phase-0' lowercase), cycle_counter (int or null), artifact_paths_affected (array of strings), context (object; free-form, includes optional keys like blocker_class, tools_available, tools_required, escalation_options, dispatch_wave, total_phase_0_tasks).

T13 void semantics observed at line 2: a transition entry carries `void: true` + `void_reason` string when a subsequent corrective brief invalidates it. The template at state-transitions-log-entry-template.md does NOT document this 'void' field — it is de facto but not documented schema.
T0-prime semantics observed at line 3: re-entry from TERMINATED back to pending when a prior T13 is voided. The template does not document the '-prime' suffix convention.

ADR-0034 is a separate, unrelated PRD-mis-credit cleanup ADR (it documents that ADR-0017 is the canonical home for the 4-cycle cap and that PRD v1.1.0 mis-credited ADR-0021). The Research Plan's '(ADR-0034 symmetric D-12 application)' phrase is itself a documentary mis-attribution. See Open Items §1 below.
